blueprints.description: Requests and approvals: an approver's inbox, my requests, a new-request wizard, request pages with their approval chain and the request types an organisation offers.

screens.name: approvals.inbox
screens.title: Inbox
screens.description: The requests waiting for my decision, with Approve, Reject and Request changes on each.

screens.name: approvals.requests
screens.title: My requests
screens.description: The requests I made, with draft, submitted, approved and rejected as chips.

screens.name: approvals.requests.new
screens.title: New request
screens.description: Request type, details, attachments, then review and submit.

screens.name: approvals.requests.page
screens.title: Request
screens.description: One request: its summary, its approval chain, its attachments and the comments.

screens.name: approvals.templates
screens.title: Templates
screens.description: The request types an organisation offers, for administrators.

screens.name: approvals.templates.edit
screens.title: Edit request type
screens.description: Edits what a request type asks for and who approves it.

templates.name: ApprovalInbox
templates.description: The requests waiting for my decision as cards, with Approve, Reject and Request changes inline.

templates.name: MyRequests
templates.description: The requests I made, with draft, submitted, approved and rejected as chips.

templates.name: NewRequestWizard
templates.description: Request type, details, attachments, then review and submit; the step survives a refresh and a draft can be saved.

templates.name: RequestPage
templates.description: One request: summary, approval chain, fields, attachments and comments, and the decision buttons.

templates.name: AllRequests
templates.description: Every request of the organisation with its type, requester, current approver and status.

templates.name: RequestTypes
templates.description: The request types an organisation offers, with the steps that approve each and whether it is active.

templates.name: RequestTypeEditForm
templates.description: A form that edits a request type: its name, what it asks for and its approval steps.

templates.name: DecisionDialog
templates.description: A confirmation with a decision (approve, reject or request changes) and a comment for the requester.

templates.name: RequestTypeQuickCreate
templates.description: A short form that adds a request type without leaving the page.
